endpoints.description: List available collections (BILLS, FR, CFR, USCODE, PLAW, etc.)
Packages in a collection updated since a date
Metadata and download links for a package

limits.notes: Uses api.data.gov key (1,000 requests/hour default per key). Search endpoint paginates via offsetMark.

llmDocs.summary: Official publications from all three branches: Federal Register, CFR, US Code, public laws, bills, Congressional Record, court opinions, budget. Bulk and granular access to authenticated PDFs/XML.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Browse by collection (/collections/{code}/{startDate}/{endDate}) or full-text search (POST /search with a query and collection filter). Package summaries link to PDF, XML, MODS, and PREMIS downloads. Use offsetMark (not page numbers) for search pagination.
gotchas: Search pagination uses offsetMark='*' for the first page then the returned nextOffsetMark — not numeric offsets.
Collection codes are uppercase abbreviations (BILLS, FR, CFR, USCODE, PLAW).
Actual document content is downloaded from links in the package summary, not inline.

compliance.redistributionNotes: Public domain. GPO provides authenticated (digitally signed) documents; preserve provenance if authenticity matters.
